question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Salty
solution:
The correct answer is **"Saline."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Salty"** means having the taste of or containing salt. (नमक के स्‍वाद वाला या नमक से भरा हुआ; नमकीन, खारा)

 
 
• **Example**: *I didn’t like the meat, it was too **salty**__.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of **Saline** are **salty, brackish, briny, seawater,** etc.
 
• **"Saline"** means containing salt or salty in taste or smell. (रासायनिक नमक से भरा हुआ; लवणीय)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The seawater was too **saline**__ to drink.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Feline **means relating to or resembling cats. (बिल्‍ली प्रजाति से संबंधित; बिल्‍ली के समान)
 
• **Prim** means overly proper or formal. ((व्‍यक्ति) ऐसा शिष्‍टता प्रिय (व्‍यक्ति) जो दूसरों की अशिष्‍टता से तुरंत परेशान हो जाए; तकल्‍लुफ़-मिज़ाज, औपचारिक)
 
• **Pricky** means full of prickles or thorns. (चुभन या काँटों से भरा हुआ)
